sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS NHANES public-use DEMO_J plus public-use Linked Mortality File

sourceFindings.observedFact: DEMO_J documents WTMEC2YR as the full sample 2 year MEC exam weight.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The public aggregate pilot can keep MEC-weight diagnostic sums, but cannot claim population inference without a reviewed survey estimator.

sourceFindings.observedFact: DEMO_J documents SDMVPSU as the masked variance pseudo-PSU.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: A variance-unit field exists in the public DEMO file, but the current model still lacks a reviewed variance implementation.

sourceFindings.observedFact: DEMO_J documents SDMVSTRA as the masked variance pseudo-stratum.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: A stratum field exists in the public DEMO file, but weighted estimates remain blocked until estimator, domain and disclosure gates pass.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS NHANES variance guidance names SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA and Taylor linearization for complex survey variance estimation.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: Taylor linearization is a documented candidate variance method, not an implemented Human Infra estimator.

analysisWeight.label: Full sample 2 year MEC exam weight
